intro: Midnight draped the glasshouse in a hush of dew, and when the dawn slipped through the panes every orchid, fern and cactus had unfurled at once, as if the night itself had whispered a shared secret. The brass tags that usually announced each species now bore fresh script, the old names erased and new ones painted in a hand that none of the gardeners recognised. In the warm, humid corridors the horticulturists moved slowly, their gloves stained with soil and their thoughts tangled like vines, each pausing to study a blossom before slipping a careful flourish onto its label. It was a habit of theirs, this private signing of every bloom, a mark that lingered long after the petals fell. By evening the glasshouse felt less a collection of plants than a ledger of quiet testimonies.
echo: A sealed glass world that has not been watered since 1960.

puzzles.title: Taproot
puzzles.flavor: It never travels in a straight line, and neither does the truth. Whoever copied it out was standing in front of a mirror.

blocks.text: The knight sets out from d8: Nb7 Na5 Nc4 Nd2.

partials.693c6c53bace50db6404f9cc0d64f76c33c1cf19: You've decoded it, but it's not finished. One more layer.

hints: Those are chess moves. Which squares does the piece land on, and what's written there? And if what you get still isn't a word, reread the flavour text.

puzzles.title: Latin Names
puzzles.flavor: Each column remembers what it held, but not in what order.
hints: Black squares are spaces. Which two- and three-letter words fit, using only the letters each column allows?

puzzles.title: Seed Bank
puzzles.flavor: Shredded, then sorted by a very tidy intern.
hints: The strips are alphabetised, not in order. The word lengths say where the breaks fall. Which strip could start the sentence?

puzzles.title: Deadheading
puzzles.flavor: Two directions at a time, and never a destination. Whoever copied it out was standing in front of a mirror.

meta.title: Meta: The Glasshouse
meta.flavor: Every report is signed with a single initial. Blaise would know what to do with them.
